name: drydock
description: Drydock — the engineering AI workbench: contained coding agents, blast-radius approvals, cross-project review.

commands.title: Isolated Run: Run Isolated Agent Prompt
Isolated Run: Probe Codex App Server Transport
Drydock: Task Hub — Back to Previous Task
Drydock: Re-enable Workspace Prompt for a Task
Drydock: Run Validation for Active Session

drydock.stateRoot.markdownDescription: Root directory for product state (SQLite event store, disposable workspaces). Leave empty to use `~/.drydock`. Managed mode always uses the fixed local location. Changing this requires a window reload.

drydock.deniedPaths.markdownDescription: Absolute paths excluded from runtime mounts, diff snapshots, and access-request approval. A mount intersecting a denied path (in either direction) is refused. Changing this requires a window reload.

drydock.disableDefaultDeniedPaths.markdownDescription: **Not recommended.** By default, sensitive home-directory config roots (`~/.ssh`, `~/.aws`, `~/.gnupg`, `~/.kube`, `~/.azure`, `~/.docker`) are merged into `#drydock.deniedPaths#` so the agent can never mount them, even via an approved access request. Enabling this removes that protection in personal mode; managed mode ignores this setting. Changing this requires a window reload.

drydock.security.allowedProjectRoots.markdownDescription: Optional absolute folders that AI may access. Empty means no personal allowlist. This can only narrow an administrator-managed Studio policy. Changing this requires a window reload.

drydock.security.cloneOnly.markdownDescription: Always use private Git clones instead of mounting live project folders. An administrator-managed Studio policy can require this. Changing this requires a window reload.

drydock.security.omitSensitiveFiles.markdownDescription: Keep common environment/credential paths (`.env*`, `secrets/`, key files, cloud config folders) out of AI clones. If one was ever tracked in reachable Git history, Drydock blocks the clone rather than pretending deletion is secure. Implies clone-only mode. Changing this requires a window reload.

drydock.security.omittedRepoPaths.markdownDescription: Exact repo-relative files or folders to keep out of AI clones (for example `config/local`); descendants are included and globs are intentionally unsupported. `.git` cannot be omitted. Tracked/history content blocks the clone. Implies clone-only mode. Changing this requires a window reload.

drydock.security.networkedAiEnabled.markdownDescription: Allow new AI requests on this machine. Turning this off prevents new turns and runtime starts; existing runtimes should be cleaned up separately. When an administrator-managed policy exists, it must also explicitly allow this machine. Changing this requires a window reload.

drydock.runtime.pathAdditions.markdownDescription: Extra directories prepended to `PATH` when Drydock runs runtime tools (`sbx` and the agent CLIs). Drydock already adds the standard Docker Desktop / Docker Sandbox bin dirs. Managed mode ignores local PATH overrides. Changing this requires a window reload.

drydock.runtime.env.markdownDescription: Additional **non-secret** environment variables for Drydock runtime tools. VS Code stores these as ordinary settings; managed mode ignores local environment overrides. Changing this requires a window reload.

drydock.runtime.copyEnv.markdownDescription: Names of environment variables to explicitly forward from the extension host to runtime tools. Drydock already inherits the host environment; managed mode ignores this setting. Changing this requires a window reload.

drydock.runtime.appServerInactivityTimeo.markdownDescription: Quiet-turn detector for Codex app-server turns: if the app-server sends no activity for this many milliseconds, Drydock logs a stall diagnostic (the turn is **not** auto-failed). The chat also offers a "Give it a poke?" nudge after ~30s of silence to try to break a standoff gracefully. Raise this if your turns legitimately run long silent operations (big builds/test suites); set to `0` to disable the diagnostic. Changing this requires a window reload.

drydock.agentIdleThresholdMinutes.markdownDescription: Minutes without delegated-agent activity before Drydock labels that agent idle in the visibility UI.

drydock.codeBlockWordWrap.markdownDescription: Wrap long lines inside chat transcript code blocks. Disable to keep horizontal scrolling.

drydock.ui.cardDetail.markdownDescription: Default detail level for cards on the Task Board and Agents panels. `minimal` shows one state chip per card and moves the rest into the hover card; each panel's toolbar **Detail** control overrides this per panel. Applies when a panel opens.

drydock.orchestrator.maxConcurrentRuns.markdownDescription: Maximum agent runs in flight at once. Further starts wait in a visible queue (manual starts jump to the front). `0` = **auto** - derived from this machine's cores and RAM (clamped 1-8).

drydock.autoAnswer.questions.markdownDescription: Master switch for task-FAQ auto-answering of agent questions. Each task ALSO has its own toggle (off by default), so nothing auto-answers until a task opts in. Every auto-answer lands in the transcript as a `[host]` receipt. Access requests are never auto-answered.

drydock.mcp.configPath.markdownDescription: Host path of an `.mcp.json` (Claude Code project-scope format: `{"mcpServers": {…}}`). Entries are IMPORTED into the MCP registry (System tab) tagged *from settings* - editable only by editing this file. Servers run INSIDE the no-egress sandbox. Claude transports only in this iteration.

tag.description: Tag applied when any glob matches, e.g. "rez".

drydock.memory.tagRules.markdownDescription: Extra glob→tag rules EXTENDING the built-in table (`package.py`→rez, `pyproject.toml`→pip, `*.py`→python, `*.h`/`*.hh`→cpp, `*.ma`→maya, …). Tags are detected per mounted root at mount time (fast top-level scan) and select which tagged team memories a session briefing carries. Example: `[{ "globs": ["*.usd", "*.usda"], "tag": "usd" }]`.

drydock.teamInstructionsPath.markdownDescription: Host path of a markdown file with studio-level standing instructions, appended to every session's host briefing (capped at 8 KB). Repo-level `CLAUDE.md`/`AGENTS.md` files are detected automatically and pointed at in the briefing.

cssPath.description: Absolute host path of the CSS file.

drydock.prototypeThemes.markdownDescription: Extra prototype theme stylesheets pushed into agent sandboxes alongside the built-ins (`qt-dark`, `slate-dark`, `vscode-dark`, `clean-light`). Agents link them from web prototypes to match a target application's look (ADR 0017).

productionUncPath.description: The REAL production location the guest must not be able to read, e.g. \\studio-fs\share\Projects.

mirrorDriveRoot.description: Root of the read-only package mirror as the guest maps it, e.g. P:\.

disallowedEgress.description: Addresses the validation runtime must NOT reach; at minimum the NAS.

drydock.validation.probeConfig.markdownDescription: What the validation runtime's standing isolation probes attempt (ADR 0022): read real production, write the package mirror, connect past the egress allowlist, and resolve the studio toolsets. **Unset leaves every probe `unknown`** - never a pass - so health reads honestly on a workstation nobody has configured yet.

drydock.validation.mirrorRoot.markdownDescription: Host path of the read-only package mirror. Its manifest version and last sync time are stamped onto every validation receipt, so a green result says which package set it was green against.

profileRef.description: Stable id of the suite; recorded in every receipt this profile produces.

argv.description: Executable + arguments, run as a process in the job workspace (never a shell string).

env.description: Extra guest environment; Drydock adds its own job-scoped variables on top.

requiredCapabilities.description: Capabilities the runtime must declare (msvc, maya, houdini…). A mismatch parks at queue time naming a runtime that has them.

licenseWaitPatterns.description: Extra regexes marking a line as a licence wait rather than a hang. Drydock's own patterns always apply.

drydock.validation.defaultProfile.markdownDescription: The validation suite **Drydock: Run Validation for Active Session** runs (ADR 0022). Without it the command says validation is not configured yet rather than inventing a suite - evidence has to be about something.
